comment: canvas-xl3a.4: the private Python the Windows installer ships (packaging/windows/build.ps1) and the C libraries it bundles, with the licence text of each, reviewed for this build. CPython's own LICENSE.txt (shipped as PYTHON-LICENSE.txt) covers CPython, bzip2 and the Microsoft Visual C++ runtime DLLs ('Additional Conditions for this Windows binary build'); cpython-3.13.17-license.txt is CPython's Doc/license.rst at v3.13.17, which also lists the code built into CPython itself (mimalloc, SipHash, dtoa, ...). Versions: the libraries report them at run time (ssl.OPENSSL_VERSION, sqlite3.sqlite_version, zlib.ZLIB_RUNTIME_VERSION, pyexpat.EXPAT_VERSION, decimal.__libmpdec_version__); libffi, xz and bzip2 from python-build-standalone's pythonbuild/downloads.json at the release tag. Texts from the release's pgo-full archive (python/licenses). tkinter, Tcl/Tk, IDLE and the test modules are removed from the install. build.ps1 fails when the release differs from this one or a DLL in the build isn't listed here: bumping Python means reviewing this again.
